```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("data_preprocessing/common/config.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r prepare_data}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SpatialFeatureExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)

output_dir <- project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/RMD files/gene_expression_metabolic_cluster_outputs")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

load(project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/IMC spe objects/New IMC/spe2025-12-17 umap.RData"))
sfe <- readRDS(project_path("Revision/Nan annotation/Data/Xenium sfe objects/Xenium sfe object/sfe_09032026.rds"))

spe$metfiblabel <- dplyr::case_when(
  spe$Rphenograph_500 %in% c("1", "2") ~ "Met_hi_Fib",
  spe$Rphenograph_500 == "3" ~ "Other_Fib",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

df_map <- data.frame(
  KEY = colnames(spe),
  metfiblabel = spe$metfiblabel,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

idx <- match(SummarizedExperiment::colData(sfe)$KEY, df_map$KEY)
sfe$metfiblabel <- df_map$metfiblabel[idx]

genes_use_subset_selected <- unique(c(
  "ACTA2", "COL8A1", "FN1", "SFRP4", "CCL19", "COL18A1", "WIF1",
  "IL6", "IL11", "CCL20", "IL1R1",
  "TNC", "LOX", "LOXL2", "MMP2", "TIMP1",
  "DCN", "LUM", "PDGFRA", "DPT",
  "PI16", "CD34",
  "FBLN2"
))

to_dgC <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "dgCMatrix")) return(x)
  x <- as(x, "CsparseMatrix")
  as(x, "dgCMatrix")
}

keep_stromal <- c("Other_Fib", "Met_hi_Fib")
cur_sfe <- sfe[, sfe$metfiblabel %in% keep_stromal]

SummarizedExperiment::assay(cur_sfe, "counts") <- to_dgC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(cur_sfe, "counts"))
SummarizedExperiment::assay(cur_sfe, "logcounts") <- to_dgC(SummarizedExperiment::assay(cur_sfe, "logcounts"))

seurat_obj <- as.Seurat(
  cur_sfe,
  counts = "counts",
  data = "logcounts"
)

Seurat::Idents(seurat_obj) <- factor(seurat_obj$metfiblabel, levels = keep_stromal)
obj_sub <- subset(seurat_obj, idents = keep_stromal)

ddata <- Seurat::DotPlot(
  obj_sub,
  features = genes_use_subset_selected,
  scale = FALSE
)$data

ddata <- ddata %>%
  mutate(
    id = factor(id, levels = keep_stromal),
    features.plot = factor(features.plot, levels = genes_use_subset_selected),
    avg.exp.raw = avg.exp
  )

raw_color_limits <- c(0, 3)

raw_fill_colors <- c("#fff7f3", "#fcae91", "#de2d26", "#7f0000")

dot_plot_unscaled <- ggplot(ddata, aes(x = id, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pct.exp, color = avg.exp.raw)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = raw_fill_colors,
    limits = raw_color_limits,
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Mean expression"
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 8), name = "% expressing") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

heatmap_unscaled <- ggplot(ddata, aes(x = id, y = features.plot, fill = avg.exp.raw)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = raw_fill_colors,
    limits = raw_color_limits,
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Mean expression"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

diff_data <- ddata %>%
  select(features.plot, id, avg.exp.raw, pct.exp) %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = id,
    values_from = c(avg.exp.raw, pct.exp),
    names_sep = "__"
  )

pseudocount <- min(ddata$avg.exp.raw[ddata$avg.exp.raw > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
if (!is.finite(pseudocount) || pseudocount <= 0) {
  pseudocount <- 1e-6
}

diff_data <- diff_data %>%
  transmute(
    features.plot = as.character(features.plot),
    contrast = "Met_hi_Fib /\nOther_Fib",
    mean_expression_other = .data[["avg.exp.raw__Other_Fib"]],
    mean_expression_met_hi = .data[["avg.exp.raw__Met_hi_Fib"]],
    pct_expression_other = .data[["pct.exp__Other_Fib"]],
    pct_expression_met_hi = .data[["pct.exp__Met_hi_Fib"]],
    log2FC = log2((mean_expression_met_hi + pseudocount) / (mean_expression_other + pseudocount)),
    delta_pct_expression = pct_expression_met_hi - pct_expression_other
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_log2FC = abs(log2FC),
    features.plot = factor(features.plot, levels = features.plot[order(log2FC)])
  )

fc_limit <- 2

fc_scale_colors <- c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
fc_legend_title <- "log2FC\nMet_hi / Other"

differential_dot_plot <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = contrast, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs_log2FC, color = log2FC)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = fc_scale_colors[1],
    mid = fc_scale_colors[2],
    high = fc_scale_colors[3],
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-fc_limit, fc_limit),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = fc_legend_title
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(2.5, 10), name = "|log2FC|") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

differential_heatmap <- ggplot(diff_data, aes(x = contrast, y = features.plot, fill = log2FC)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_scale_colors[1],
    mid = fc_scale_colors[2],
    high = fc_scale_colors[3],
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-fc_limit, fc_limit),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = fc_legend_title
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

diff_data_dotplot_order <- diff_data %>%
  mutate(features.plot = factor(as.character(features.plot), levels = genes_use_subset_selected))

differential_dot_plot_dotplot_order <- ggplot(diff_data_dotplot_order, aes(x = contrast, y = features.plot)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs_log2FC, color = log2FC)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = fc_scale_colors[1],
    mid = fc_scale_colors[2],
    high = fc_scale_colors[3],
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-fc_limit, fc_limit),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = fc_legend_title
  ) +
  scale_size(range = c(2.5, 10), name = "|log2FC|") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

differential_heatmap_dotplot_order <- ggplot(diff_data_dotplot_order, aes(x = contrast, y = features.plot, fill = log2FC)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.45, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = fc_scale_colors[1],
    mid = fc_scale_colors[2],
    high = fc_scale_colors[3],
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-fc_limit, fc_limit),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = fc_legend_title
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_dotplot_unscaled_raw_mean.pdf"), dot_plot_unscaled, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_heatmap_unscaled_raw_mean.pdf"), heatmap_unscaled, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_dotplot_log2fc.pdf"), differential_dot_plot, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_heatmap_log2fc.pdf"), differential_heatmap, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_dotplot_log2fc_dotplot_order.pdf"), differential_dot_plot_dotplot_order, width = 6, height = 6)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_heatmap_log2fc_dotplot_order.pdf"), differential_heatmap_dotplot_order, width = 6, height = 6)

if (requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_dotplot_unscaled_raw_mean.svg"), dot_plot_unscaled, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_heatmap_unscaled_raw_mean.svg"), heatmap_unscaled, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_dotplot_log2fc.svg"), differential_dot_plot, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_heatmap_log2fc.svg"), differential_heatmap, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_dotplot_log2fc_dotplot_order.svg"), differential_dot_plot_dotplot_order, width = 6, height = 6)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_heatmap_log2fc_dotplot_order.svg"), differential_heatmap_dotplot_order, width = 6, height = 6)
}

write.csv(ddata, file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_dotplot_unscaled_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(diff_data, file.path(output_dir, "selected_gene_differential_log2fc_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
